headline: Sales and margins climb as full-year guidance is raised
summary_short: Wabtec's Q2 2026 sales rose 17.5% y/y to $3.18B with GAAP diluted EPS up 18.9% to $2.33, as adjusted operating margin expanded 0.8pts to 21.9% and the company raised full-year revenue and adjusted EPS guidance.
summary_long: Sales grew 17.5% y/y to $3.18B, driven by Freight (+16.9%) and Transit (+18.9%), with the Inspection Technologies, Frauscher, and Dellner Couplers acquisitions contributing. GAAP operating margin rose 1.5pts to 18.9% and adjusted operating margin rose 0.8pts to 21.9% on gross-margin gains, partly offset by higher opex as a percent of revenue. Multi-year backlog reached $30.93B, up 41.7% y/y. Operating cash flow rose to $441M from $209M on higher net income and working capital; the company repurchased $215M of stock and paid $53M in dividends. Cash fell to $670M and long-term debt rose to $6,571M on acquisition-related financing. Wabtec raised 2026 revenue guidance to $12.30-12.60B and adjusted EPS guidance to $10.60-10.90, up $110M/$0.30 at the midpoint respectively.

drivers.explanation: Sales growth driven by higher Freight and Transit sales, including the Inspection Technologies, Frauscher Sensor Technologies, and Dellner Couplers acquisitions.
GAAP and adjusted operating margins benefited from robust sales growth and improved gross margins in the quarter.
GAAP and adjusted EPS increased primarily due to higher sales and operating margin expansion.
Cash fell y/y as investing activities (including acquisitions) used $1,160M YTD against $640M of YTD operating cash flow; not decomposed to Q2 alone in the release.
CEO cited robust sales growth, margin expansion, a 22% rise in adjusted EPS, and momentum from recent acquisition integrations and commercial awards.
